searchText: I just want to clarify https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7691 's update fraction change... `BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION_ELECTRA | 5007716` is confusing because _ELECTRA is a CL suffix and The naming is different: `BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION` != `BLOB_GAS_PRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION` as per https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4844, but I'm pretty sure this is a change on the EL side... Are we simply updating the **Cancun** value of `BLOB_GAS_PRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION = 3338477` to be `BLOB_GAS_PRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION = 5007716` in **Prague**? And no change to the calculation itself? Yeah right. The rest of the base fee mechanism stays untouched. The final value was chosen as a compromise base fee update sensitivity. Check this PR for more context: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9060

excerpts.author: siladu
excerpts.content:
I just want to clarify https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7691 's update fraction change...

`BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION_ELECTRA | 5007716` is confusing because _ELECTRA is a CL suffix and
The naming is different: `BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION` !=  `BLOB_GAS_PRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION` as per https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4844, but I'm pretty sure this is a change on the EL side...

Are we simply updating the **Cancun** value of `BLOB_GAS_PRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION = 3338477` to be `BLOB_GAS_PRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION = 5007716` in **Prague**?
And no change to the calculation itself?

excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content:
Yeah right. The rest of the base fee mechanism stays untouched.
The final value was chosen as a compromise base fee update sensitivity.
Check this PR for more context:
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9060
